method: Official nomination dossier, excavator-published phase plans, attributed OSM geometry and browser-inspected photographs. No reference pixels distributed.

observations.observation: Pages 15–20 describe the lake, 38 bastions, original 13 m wall, roofless surviving sanctuary walls, 10 by 27 m western iwan and 20.5 m four-column building. Original wall height is not used as the surviving height.

Inspected Sasanian phase plan: oval enclosure, lake, northern square, eastern main fire sanctuary, western column halls and western projecting palace. Geometry in the recipe is a proportional interpretation, not a survey or pixel tracing.
Inspected Ilkhanid phase plan: western iwan octagons, lake arcade foundations, new southern axial entry and the oblique isolated four-column hall.
Column hall photograph has low round brick columns, square stump piers, roofless walls and open sky.
Inspected 2017 photograph: tall broken wall fragments, exposed irregular brick/rubble core and temporary scaffolding. No complete iwan arch or intact palace roof.
Inspected elevated view: low oval wall with round bastions, broad spring lake and predominantly low interior ruins. Western iwan is the dominant tall fragment.
Inspected brick arch and low cruciform piers/basin; temporary supporting wood is visible. Exact restoration scope needs further verification.
